ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40% high-intensity white/light-gray area to 60% low-intensity dark-gray/black area across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe: light-toned base with dense, dark-pigment streaks concentrated in the central and outer zones. Right lobe: contiguous dark-pigment field with sparse light-gray patches near the leading edge and median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow, acute-angled V-shaped notch; depth is approximately 25% of the vertical height of the central fluke area.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrations along the entire trailing edge with peak-to-valley amplitudes varying between 2 and 15 pixels; distinct jaggedness on both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge extending from the median notch toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of white, circular, high-contrast pixel groups (barnacles) located on both the extreme left and right distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple parallel and intersecting dark linear marks on the light-pigmented background of the left lobe; most prominent are vertical scratches in the mid-lobe region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Circular, light-toned ring scar visible on the lower interior section of the left lobe; extensive biological encrustations on distal fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant pigmentation asymmetry between the left lobe (high-contrast linear streaks) and the right lobe (dense dark mottling).
